notes:
Notes for the question "do the Raptors play tonight", with today as Monday, Oct 12, 2026. No place was given. The Raptors schedule doesn't depend on the asker's location.

- The Raptors do not appear to play tonight, Monday Oct 12. The NBA.com schedule for the Raptors goes straight from a preseason game on Oct 10 (vs. the Clippers in Vancouver) to the next one on Oct 13. No game is listed for Oct 12. The Yahoo Sports calendar and the ESPN schedule also show nothing for Oct 12.
- Their next game is tomorrow, Tuesday Oct 13. It is a preseason game against the New York Knicks at Scotiabank Arena in Toronto, listed at 7:00 pm ET on NBA.com. ESPN and sync2cal give the same time. Yahoo lists the TV channel as SN. Raptors Republic describes it as a 7 PM match against the New York Knicks in Toronto on October 13.
- One source disagrees. The Sports Media Watch TV schedule page (dated 7 days ago) has a "Today" entry for the Clippers game and a "Tuesday, October 13" entry for the Knicks game. The Clippers game was on Oct 10, so that page is stale. It doesn't show a game on Oct 12.
- Latest results: Oct 3 vs. Miami, L 129-105; Oct 10 vs. the Clippers, W 114-106. That makes them 1-1 in the preseason.
- The next games after that are Oct 15 at the Knicks (7:30 pm ET, Madison Square Garden) and Oct 16 at the Pistons (7:00 pm ET). The regular season opens for them on Oct 21 vs. Chicago.
- One oddity: a Fubo page for the Knicks lists Oct 12 as a Knicks home game vs. Minnesota. That is a different team's game and doesn't involve the Raptors.
